"""Compare expanded affine rows with direct exact interval extrema."""
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import json
import subprocess
import sys


PROBE = "const charts=[[0n,1n,1n],[1n,4n,1n],[1n,5n,1n],[1n,8n,1n],[1n,11n,1n],[1n,12n,1n],[1n,45n,1n]];\nconst samples=[];\nfor(const [ca,x] of charts.entries()) {\n  for(const circuit of [...circuits[3],...circuits[7]].filter(q=>q.indices.includes(0))) {\n    const bank=circuit.indices.map(k=>k?fixedPatterns(groups[k],k):variablePatterns(groups[k]));\n    for(let i=0;i<bank[0].length;i++) {\n      const words=[];\n      for(let k=0;k<4;k++) words[circuit.indices[k]]=bank[k][k===0?i:(3*i+2*ca+k)%bank[k].length];\n      const singleton=circuit.indices.every(k=>words[k].zero);\n      for(const side of [1n,-1n]) {\n        const bounds=circuit.indices.map((k,j)=>{\n          const w=side*circuit.weights[j];\n          const rows=words[k][w>0n?\"upper\":\"lower\"];\n          return {w:String(w),values:rows.map(r=>[String(dot(r.slice(0,3),x)),String(r[3])])};\n        });\n        samples.push({singleton,bounds,got:sumBounds(circuit.indices,circuit.weights,words,side)\n          .every(r=>singleton ? dot(r,x)>=0n:dot(r,x)>0n)});\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\nreturn samples;"


def main():
    replay, frozen_source, wedge_file = map(Path, sys.argv[1:4])
    base = wedge_file.read_text()
    prefix = base.split("let states=", 1)[0]
    with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        patch = Path(directory) / "affine_probe.js"
        patch.write_text(prefix + PROBE + "\n")
        samples = json.loads(subprocess.run(
            ["node", str(replay), str(frozen_source), str(patch)],
            check=True, capture_output=True, text=True,
        ).stdout)

    for sample in samples:
        if any(not bound["values"] for bound in sample["bounds"]):
            direct = True
        else:
            total = sum(
                min(int(bound["w"]) * Fraction(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in bound["values"])
                for bound in sample["bounds"]
            )
            direct = total >= 0 if sample["singleton"] else total > 0
        assert sample["got"] == direct
    assert len(samples) == 7392
    print(len(samples), "exact affine endpoint tests matched")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
